1) Exec asks spreadsheet: finalize one-slide responses for each ask and attach evidence (Marissa) (8/17 EOD) — see QBR_exec_asks.xlsx attached.
2) SLA/Latency table: finalize per-route expected p50/p95 delta across Dedicated vs Hosted (Vivek) (8/16 noon) — we need numbers for the ops slide.
3) SOW redlines for NovaProd: incorporate legal notes and present decision points (Karthik) (8/18 EOD) — SOW_draft_v2.pdf attached for context.
4) Cost delta analysis: quantization + batching recommendation for customer POC (Lauren) (8/17 EOD).
5) Rollout risk register: list top 3 risks and mitigations for Dedicated capacity (Marissa + Vivek) (8/17 EOD).
6) Customer-facing Qs we couldn't resolve in sync: summarize to send to customer by EOD Monday (Markus) (8/17 EOD).

Quick notes: the exec asks sheet has placeholders where I expect the one-slide answers; Marissa — if you can fill the evidence link column that will save time in review. Karthik — legal called out two durable-data clauses; flag them in the SOW redline so we can weigh in.

Thanks — short and actionable. I’ll run a dry-run checklist on 8/19 and send invites for the QBR rehearsal.

Hi Markus / Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying points from our side so we can align with procurement and get SOW signed quickly: 

1) Pricing ask: the exec slide references a peak RPS assumption of 1200. Can you confirm the cost delta if we opt for the Dedicated pool vs Hosted for the first 90 days? We need a rough figure to brief procurement.
2) SLA clarification: procurement wants explicit p99 SLA target and penalties spelled out in the SOW redline. Is that in scope for this SOW draft?
3) Timeline: procurement is prepared to move fast but needs an approved SOW + PO by 8/23 to meet their fiscal close. Any chance we can accelerate reviews?

We can provide a PO template; looping procurement so they see the dates. If it helps, we’d prefer any exec-facing numbers in a single slide that we can hand to our CFO at the QBR.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that speeds things up.
